LeKiwi teleop lifecycle
hyperedges.description: Four-script lifecycle on a remote LeKiwi client: teleoperate for live SO100Leader + keyboard control, record to capture episodes into a LeRobotDataset, replay to stream recorded actions back to the robot, and evaluate to run a pretrained ACT policy and record inference episodes.

hyperedges.label: Phone->SO100 EE teleop lifecycle
hyperedges.description: Four-script lifecycle on a SO100Follower: phone-pose -> EE deltas -> IK joint commands teleop, record to capture EE action + EE observation, replay to stream EE actions through an IK processor in open-loop, and evaluate to run a pretrained ACT policy in EE space.

hyperedges.label: SO100->SO100 EE teleop lifecycle
hyperedges.description: Four-script lifecycle on a SO100Leader + SO100Follower pair in the EE action space: FK on leader + FK/IK on follower for live teleop, record into a LeRobotDataset with EE features, replay EE actions through IK open-loop, and evaluate a pretrained ACT policy with FK/IK processors.

hyperedges.label: HIL data collection script pair
hyperedges.description: Human-in-the-Loop (Robot-as-Chunk) data collection: hil_data_collection.py runs the rollout loop with optional RTC background inference, while hil_utils.py provides the HILDatasetConfig, pynput keyboard listener, identity processors, and reset loop that hil_data_collection.py imports from.

hyperedges.label: SLURM DROID porting pipeline
hyperedges.description: End-to-end SLURM pipeline to convert the TFDS DROID dataset (Franka, 2048 shards) into a single LeRobotDataset on the Hub: port_droid contains the per-shard conversion core, slurm_port_shards runs it across SLURM workers, slurm_aggregate_shards combines the per-rank datasets, slurm_upload pushes the aggregated dataset to the Hub in chunked commits, and display_error_files lists SLURM workers that failed.

hyperedges.label: RTC evaluation deployment modes
hyperedges.description: Two deployment modes for evaluating Real-Time Chunking: eval_dataset.py runs an offline comparison on dataset samples (loading the policy three times sequentially to manage VRAM) and emits matplotlib denoising plots; eval_with_real_robot.py runs a threaded demo on a physical robot where a get_actions thread keeps an ActionQueue filled with RTC-guided chunks while an actor thread streams actions through an ActionInterpolator.

hyperedges.label: async-inference client/server
hyperedges.description: Async inference pair: policy_server.py hosts a trained policy via lerobot.async_inference.policy_server.serve, and robot_client.py runs RobotClient.control_loop(task) on an SO100Follower that streams observations to the server and receives action chunks back (actions_per_chunk=50, chunk_size_threshold=0.5).

hyperedges.label: ACT train-then-deploy
hyperedges.description: ACT pipeline: act_training_example.py trains ACTConfig/ACTPolicy on a LeRobot v3 dataset and pushes to the Hub; act_using_example.py loads that checkpoint and drives an SO100Follower in a closed-loop 5x20 control loop with two OpenCV cameras.

hyperedges.label: Diffusion train-then-deploy
hyperedges.description: Diffusion pipeline mirroring the ACT pair: train DiffusionConfig/DiffusionPolicy on a LeRobot v3 dataset, push to the Hub, then load the checkpoint and run inference on an SO100Follower.

hyperedges.label: HIL-SERL RL training toolkit
hyperedges.description: RL training toolkit: reward_classifier_example.py trains a ResNet-18-backed RewardClassifier on a LeRobot v3 demo dataset and pushes it to the Hub; hilserl_example.py loads that classifier, spawns a multiprocess actor+learner SAC trainer, mixes online (autonomous + intervention) and offline (intervention-only) replay buffers, and terminates episodes when the classifier's predicted reward crosses 1.0.

hyperedges.label: User MCAP->LeRobot v3 data prep tool
hyperedges.description: Standalone data preparation tool that turns Octopus ROS2 MCAP recordings into LeRobot v3 datasets consumable by the training scripts in this chunk and chunk 3. Encodes the 14D action and 26D observation.state schema, the inspire_hand_v1 tactile pseudo-image layout, the q99.5 fixed-scale normalization strategy, and the 50 ms extrapolation gate that drops anchor frames whose critical streams are too stale.

nodes.label: MCAP -> LeRobot v3 converter
nodes.description: Converts Octopus ROS2 .mcap recordings (top/left/right Realsense, /vla_teleop proprio+action, /inspire hand joint+cmd, 11 mono16 tactile taxels per hand) to a LeRobot v3 dataset for pi0.5 training. Anchors the timeline on the top camera header.stamp; applies a strict 50 ms nearest-neighbour gate for images and tactile; resamples numeric streams linearly (or continuously when --numeric-interp-mode continuous). Locks visual schema to 224x224x3, action to 14D (2*6 arm cmd + 2*1 hand cmd), observation.state to 26D (2*6 arm qpos + 2*1 hand qpos + 2*6 EE xyz+rpy). Supports RGB-only and VTLA modes (the latter gated by --include-tactile and refusing to mix schemas in the same --out directory). Tactile pseudo-image uses a fixed inspire_hand_v1 layout (taxels 12/13/22/23/32/33/42/43/52/54 in a 5x2 grid plus taxel 61 stretched across the bottom row) with R=abs(raw-baseline), G=positive_delta, B=negative_delta, baseline = first 1.0 s median, and pressure/delta scales fixed to the train-set q99.5 percentile (or user-supplied --tactile-pressure-scale / --tactile-delta-scale) and persisted to meta/tactile_preprocess.json. Episode splitting happens on time gaps > max(50 ms, 1.5/fps) and on annotation JSON segment boundaries.

hyperedges.description: Four-script lifecycle on a remote LeKiwi client: teleoperate for live SO100Leader + keyboard control, record to capture episodes into a LeRobotDataset, replay to stream recorded actions back to the robot, and evaluate to run a pretrained ACT policy and record inference episodes.

hyperedges.label: Phone->SO100 EE teleop lifecycle
hyperedges.description: Four-script lifecycle on a SO100Follower: phone-pose -> EE deltas -> IK joint commands teleop, record to capture EE action + EE observation, replay to stream EE actions through an IK processor in open-loop, and evaluate to run a pretrained ACT policy in EE space.

hyperedges.label: SO100->SO100 EE teleop lifecycle
hyperedges.description: Four-script lifecycle on a SO100Leader + SO100Follower pair in the EE action space: FK on leader + FK/IK on follower for live teleop, record into a LeRobotDataset with EE features, replay EE actions through IK open-loop, and evaluate a pretrained ACT policy with FK/IK processors.

hyperedges.label: HIL data collection script pair
hyperedges.description: Human-in-the-Loop (Robot-as-Chunk) data collection: hil_data_collection.py runs the rollout loop with optional RTC background inference, while hil_utils.py provides the HILDatasetConfig, pynput keyboard listener, identity processors, and reset loop that hil_data_collection.py imports from.

hyperedges.label: SLURM DROID porting pipeline
hyperedges.description: End-to-end SLURM pipeline to convert the TFDS DROID dataset (Franka, 2048 shards) into a single LeRobotDataset on the Hub: port_droid contains the per-shard conversion core, slurm_port_shards runs it across SLURM workers, slurm_aggregate_shards combines the per-rank datasets, slurm_upload pushes the aggregated dataset to the Hub in chunked commits, and display_error_files lists SLURM workers that failed.

hyperedges.label: RTC evaluation deployment modes
hyperedges.description: Two deployment modes for evaluating Real-Time Chunking: eval_dataset.py runs an offline comparison on dataset samples (loading the policy three times sequentially to manage VRAM) and emits matplotlib denoising plots; eval_with_real_robot.py runs a threaded demo on a physical robot where a get_actions thread keeps an ActionQueue filled with RTC-guided chunks while an actor thread streams actions through an ActionInterpolator.

hyperedges.label: async-inference client/server
hyperedges.description: Async inference pair: policy_server.py hosts a trained policy via lerobot.async_inference.policy_server.serve, and robot_client.py runs RobotClient.control_loop(task) on an SO100Follower that streams observations to the server and receives action chunks back (actions_per_chunk=50, chunk_size_threshold=0.5).

hyperedges.label: ACT train-then-deploy
hyperedges.description: ACT pipeline: act_training_example.py trains ACTConfig/ACTPolicy on a LeRobot v3 dataset and pushes to the Hub; act_using_example.py loads that checkpoint and drives an SO100Follower in a closed-loop 5x20 control loop with two OpenCV cameras.

hyperedges.label: Diffusion train-then-deploy
hyperedges.description: Diffusion pipeline mirroring the ACT pair: train DiffusionConfig/DiffusionPolicy on a LeRobot v3 dataset, push to the Hub, then load the checkpoint and run inference on an SO100Follower.

hyperedges.label: HIL-SERL RL training toolkit
hyperedges.description: RL training toolkit: reward_classifier_example.py trains a ResNet-18-backed RewardClassifier on a LeRobot v3 demo dataset and pushes it to the Hub; hilserl_example.py loads that classifier, spawns a multiprocess actor+learner SAC trainer, mixes online (autonomous + intervention) and offline (intervention-only) replay buffers, and terminates episodes when the classifier's predicted reward crosses 1.0.

hyperedges.label: User MCAP->LeRobot v3 data prep tool
hyperedges.description: Standalone data preparation tool that turns Octopus ROS2 MCAP recordings into LeRobot v3 datasets consumable by the training scripts in this chunk and chunk 3. Encodes the 14D action and 26D observation.state schema, the inspire_hand_v1 tactile pseudo-image layout, the q99.5 fixed-scale normalization strategy, and the 50 ms extrapolation gate that drops anchor frames whose critical streams are too stale.
